intro: Tucked away in the far northwestern corner of Silithus, the Crystal Vale is a remote canyon dominated by jagged mineral spires and swirling elemental forces. Earth and air elementals roam its rocky flats, guarding rich veins of raw ore. It is also a site of potent summoning magic, deeply tied to the ancient elemental lords.

sections.t: A Confluence of Stone and Wind
p: The Crystal Vale stands distinct from the barren desert sands of southern Silithus. Framed by steep cliffs, the basin is filled with shimmering crystalloid formations, roaming earthen elementals, and roaring whirlwinds of living air. Rich deposits of thorium draw occasional daring prospectors, but the vale is far from quiet. The elemental beings here are inherently hostile to intruders, guarding a realm that feels steeped in the primal conflicts of primordial Azeroth.
